title: Montserrat and Cava Winery tour
text:
Dory was great to work with, responded to questions quickly. Provided updates on time or location pickup. 
The small group was great. Our tour guide Vincent provided tons of information during our drive to Montserrat. The cava tasting was good. 
It was a great way to spend the day in Barcelona. Would definitely use this company again for another tour.

title: Must do tour great value it's spectacular
text:
Great tour with Tatiana as our guide 
They picked us up from the ship and we went to Monserrat for our first time 
If you have not been there you should definitely put it on your list 
Then we went to the Sagrada and got to walk around the neighborhood 
We have been to Barcelona many times and this was one of the best days ever

title: Wonderful Day
text: We did a full day tour that included a trip to monserat. Our driver was named Hugo. He was outstanding, as was the tour of barcelona.  We had four people in our tour and were toured in a mercedes van.  Everything was top notch and hugo was wonderful..
author: 115richm

title: An excellent in depth...
text: An excellent in depth tour of most of the important highlights of both cities. Christona, our tour guide gave a much better outside tour for example of La Familia than the tour we had several years ago.,she took us around all sides of this magnificent structure and explained everything about each side. Our best tour yet.
author: Neal_G

title: the BEST
text: We have 26 ports and this by far was the best and greatest tour that we’ve ever taken (400+ sea days). Our guide, Marta, was just fantastic. Both in Montserrat and in Barcelona, she was a wealth of knowledge and encouraged our questions. I don’t see how any tour could surpass this. We just hope we have some that could equal it.  We cancelled this tour and then subsequently booked it  again.  They  refunded us without any difficulty and helped us with rebooking.
author: drgeorgej

title: A day to remember- Wonerful Montserrat and Cava tasting
text: We had an excellent day with Spain Day Tours visiting Montserrat, followed by a lovely cava tasting. Our guide’s knowledge was outstanding and made the whole experience so interesting and enjoyable. It was a wonderful journey and one we’ll always remember. We would highly recommend this tour.
author: deborahwS6987CE

title: Barcelona and Granada
text: So, where do I begin………. I booked two tours with Spain day tours. The first tour we booked at Granada for Alhambra.  Our tour guide Carlos not only did a good job. He did a great job.  He explained every part of Alhambra in great detail and answered every single question anybody had regardless of how insignificant it was.  He was truly articulate, personable and friendly. title: Would book again!
text: Our tour included pickup at the cruise terminal, a trip to Montserrat, a visit to a Cava winery, and drop-off at our hotel.  It was a full day filled with great conversation and experiences. Our guide and driver were both very helpful throughout the day.  Great value and I would book tours through this company again.
